arc.energy_shape_notes: One unbroken ramp, one snap, one re-keyed return. First half: 30s RMS means rise monotonically -15.4dB (0-30s) to -8.2dB (210-240s) with no valley or false drop. At 5:00 the entire 14.0dB dynamic range discharges in a single 5s step (-7.4dB at 295-300s -> -21.4dB at 300-305s), simultaneous with spectral collapse (centroid 638Hz) and a G# minor -> G# major flip. Second half averages the same loudness as the first (-11.1dB vs -11.0dB) but oscillates between limiter-pinned peaks (21 windows at exactly 0.0dBFS) and sudden 5s holes (-15.5 to -16.8dB). Ends dark and cut off: centroid 2742 -> 942Hz over the final ~25s, a -16.8dB hole at 605-610s, then one loud dark hit (-8.4dB RMS) and a hard stop at 616.1s. No fade.

harmony.home_scale: G# natural minor (G# A# B C# D# E F#) for 0:00-5:00; parallel G# major from 5:00 to end. One-way flip, held - not an oscillating vamp.
signature_devices: One-way parallel-major flip at the structural hinge (here 5:00): static root G#, minor 3rd B -> major 3rd C, hold major to the end. Chroma corroboration: B mean 0.36-0.43 pre-flip -> 0.17-0.24 post; C 0.19-0.29 -> 0.31-0.40. Trap: naive key detector reads the second half as alternating G# maj / C# maj - it is the same roots in parallel major, not modulation.
No functional harmony anywhere: no leading tone, no V-i cadences. The flip is a mode switch, not a cadence; the track ends on tonic major.
Early key confidence is high (G# min 0.86-0.94 in first 90s; flip window G# maj 0.93); late major reads weaken (0.331 at 540s) - trust the flip, soften the late I-IV alternation.

signature_devices: Locked bar grid: 370 bar downbeats, mean interval 1.647s, SD 0.049s. NOTE: beat_times_s are bar starts, not beats (370x4=1480 ~= n_beats 1479).

Tempo arch following the pressure curve: 143.6 -> ~152 at 120-300s (bar intervals imply ~151 at 180-240s) -> sag ~140-142 at 300-420s -> ~144 to the end. The 136 BPM per-minute read at 600s is a partial-minute artifact (bar intervals imply ~142); do not build an ending slowdown.
Unrelieved ramp: 30s RMS means rise monotonically for 5 minutes with no valley or false drop - the climb must not let off pressure anywhere.
Single-window holes as punctuation in the second half: 5s dropouts to -15.5...-16.8dB at 315, 370, 475-485, 605s inside otherwise loud material.

tempo.feel: Steady grid-locked pulse with a tempo arch: pushes ~144 -> ~152 into the first peak, sags to ~140-142 after the 5:00 cliff, recovers to ~144. No swing/backbeat/polyrhythm evidence in this data - do not invent groove detail.

timbre.palette_notes: Bright and noisy by default: centroid mostly 2900-3500Hz, bandwidth ~2900-3100Hz, rolloff ~6500-7500Hz, ZCR 0.08-0.17; brightest window 4056Hz/8766Hz at 20s. Two dark collapses: at the cliff (285-300s: centroid 1380->638Hz, rolloff ->1132Hz, bandwidth 1319Hz, ZCR 0.0177, MFCC0 -201.5) and the outro (600-616s: centroid 2127->942Hz, rolloff 4951->1483Hz, MFCC0 -175.6) - the track gets darker, not quieter, as it ends. First peak (210-240s) is the least noisy passage (ZCR 0.072-0.093 vs 0.13 average). No stereo/flatness/band-energy data in features, so no width, noise-burst, or sub-bass claims.
